item.title: 40 nostalgic pictures to take you back to Glasgow in the 1950s and 1960s
item.description: In the decades following the Second World War, Glasgow stood at a crossroads. Once celebrated as the Second City of the Empire, it entered the 1950s and 1960s facing stark industrial decline, sweeping urban change, and profound social transformation. These years reshaped the city’s skyline, economy, and identity, laying the groundwork for the modern Glasgow we know today.
